title: Disease Node (disease-layer-v1)
description: Canonical disease node. Primary key = MONDO id (D-GATE-1, default-applied). Aligned to FR-001 / SC-001. Source/ontology = MONDO, DO as supplementary cross-reference (DECISIONS 003).

disease_id.description: Primary key. MONDO id (D-GATE-1 default-applied). Stable, cross-source-aligned canonical identity.

aliases.description: Synonyms / alternative names. Controlled dedup required (FR-014).

external_ids.description: Traceable cross-references to other ontologies/sources (DO, ICD, OMIM, UMLS, etc.). DO is supplementary mapping, not canonical (DECISIONS 003).
